mapper.sql: id, order_id, product_id, sku_id, sku_code, product_name, specification, unit, price, quantity, amount
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN `order` o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.order_number = #{orderNumber}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO order_item ( order_id, product_id, sku_id, sku_code, product_name, specification, unit, price, quantity, amount ) VALUES
(#{item.orderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.skuId}, #{item.skuCode}, #{item.productName}, #{item.specification}, #{item.unit}, #{item.price}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.amount})
mapper.select: SELECT cashier_id, cashier_name, COUNT(id) as orderCount, SUM(actual_amount) as salesAmount FROM `order` WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND payment_status = 'PAID' GROUP BY cashier_id, cashier_name ORDER BY salesAmount DESC

SELECT
DATE(create_time) as date, DATE(create_time) as period,
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as period,
'total' as type, 'total' as period,
COUNT(id) as orderCount, SUM(actual_amount) as salesAmount FROM `order` WHERE order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND payment_status = 'PAID'
AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT oi.product_id, oi.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) as salesVolume, SUM(oi.amount) as salesAmount, SUM(p.purchase_price * oi.quantity) as totalCost, (SUM(oi.amount) - SUM(p.purchase_price * oi.quantity)) as profit FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN product p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.order_id IN ( SELECT id FROM `order` WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND payment_status = 'PAID' ) GROUP BY oi.product_id, oi.product_name ORDER BY profit DESC
